items.title: 13.2 Halogens ki volatility ka rujhan (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.2 with Table 13.2, printed page 293.

blocks.text: Halogens non-polar hain, to un ki volatility mein instantaneous dipole-induced dipole quwatein bunyadi kirdar ada karti hain. Yeh quwatein molecular size, shakal aur polarisability par munhasir hain: mazboot quwatein kam volatility aur zyada boiling points deti hain. Kamzor id-id quwaton wale madde, chhote, kam polarisable molecules ke saath, kam boiling points aur zyada volatility rakhte hain; bare, zyada polarisable molecules mazboot London dispersion quwaton ke saath zyada boiling points aur kam volatility rakhte hain. Volatility boiling point ke ulat hai: zyada volatile madde ka boiling point kam hota hai, kyunke mazboot intermolecular quwaton ko molecules liquid se gas mein alag karne ke liye zyada energy chahiye (Table 13.2).

blocks.caption: Physical khusoosiyat par London quwaton ka asar (Table 13.2)

blocks.text: Pehle do halogens, fluorine (be-rang ya bohat halka sabz) aur chlorine (sabzi-mail peela), kamzor id-id quwaton ki wajah se gases hain. Bromine liquid hai kyunke us ka molecule bara hai aur fluorine aur chlorine se mazboot intermolecular quwatein rakhta hai; iodine group mein sab se mazboot quwatein rakhti hai, to kamre ke darja hararat par solid hai.

blocks.prompt: Halogens ki volatility ke rujhan mein London dispersion quwaton ka kya kirdar hai (exercise Q.2d)?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke X2 molecules non-polar hain, London dispersion quwatein un ke darmiyan wahid kashish hain. Yeh quwatein electrons ki tadaad aur molecule ki polarisability ke saath barhti hain, to fluorine ke liye sab se kamzor aur iodine ke liye sab se mazboot hain; phir molecules azad karne ko zyada energy chahiye, boiling points group mein neeche barhte hain, aur volatility ghat-ti hai.

items: Non-polar X2: volatility instantaneous dipole-induced dipole quwaton se tay, jo size aur polarisability ke saath barhti hain; mazboot quwatein, zyada b.p., kam volatility. F2 aur Cl2 gases, Br2 liquid, I2 solid.
